home.title: Soccer predictions built on probabilities, not hunches
paragraphs: IASHARK produces soccer predictions from statistical models (Poisson, Dixon-Coles, Elo ratings and Monte Carlo simulation). For Betway Premiership (PSL) fixtures, the Premier League, the Champions League and the other competitions we cover, the model estimates the probability of each result, the number of goals and both teams to score, then compares it with the probability implied by bookmaker odds.

These are statistical estimates: soccer is uncertain, no outcome is guaranteed and IASHARK is not a bookmaker. PSL coverage is recent and data quality varies by league, so every analysis shows its data-quality rating. 18+ only.
